# Daily Report — 2026-08-31

## Task Completed
Added `get_incident_sla` tool — retrieves a single SLA tracking record
(task_sla) by sys_id and validates it is scoped to the incident table
(`table_name=incident`). Returns a 404-style failure if the record does not
exist or belongs to a different table. Normalises reference fields (task,
sla) to display values via `_format_task_sla`. The tool uses `GetIncidentSLAParams`
(required `task_sla_id`) and is registered in the service_desk,
system_administrator, and full packages.
